text:
elaine: Quick thread to finalize observability canary guardrails for the console launch (dashboards + traces + cost). Need must-haves vs v2.

ryan: Proposal: v1 = lightweight dashboard tiles + sampled traces + route/model cost summary. Blockers: sampling defaults, trace access control, CSV performance.

marta: Infra: default sampling 0.5%-1% org-configurable. Spans must be streamed async to avoid blocking.

gabe: Acceptance checklist:
- Widgets: cost-by-route (24h/7d), error sparkline, top-5 latency hotspots (CSV export, paginated)
- Tracing: emit trace_id/span_id for generation requests; sampled linkable traces at 1% default
- Cost: per-model token totals and $ estimate for windows

nina: Security: only users with obs:read_traces can view raw traces; audit log on access; basic PII scrub on traces.

elaine: Launch gates:
- latency: p95 no more than +5% vs baseline across canary orgs
- errors: absolute error rate increase <= +0.5%
- stability: no CPU/GPU OOMs during 2-week canary

marta: Ops will create alerts and an automated rollback playbook if p95 breaches for 15m or ingestion lag >30s.

gabe: V2 backlog: request replay, deep error grouping, dynamic sampling, improved PII scrub.

ops-bot: canary deploy started: obs/console-v1 -> 5% cohorts. Link: https://deploys.redwood/obs/1768221111

elaine: Final v1 carve: three widgets (cost-by-route, error-sparkline, latency-hotspots), trace_id/span_id emission, 1% sampling default (org-configurable), RBAC for trace access, paginated CSV export.

ryan: Next check-in Wed 9am to review canary metrics; if failed, pause rollout and notify oncall.

ops-bot: alert rule created: obs-canary-p95-rollback (p95 > baseline *1.05 for 15m)
